title: Vickers Wellington DV930
memorial_details: Original brass commemorative plaque with incised lettering on wooden background. Tapestry featuring poppies in black, glazed frame added at 75th anniversary of crash
inscription: Brass plaque: THIS PLAQUE HAS BEEN ERECTED BY THE PEOPLE OF / CHEDISTON TO COMMEMORATE THE BRAVERY OF THE CREW OF / A VICKERS WELLINGTON BOMBER MK. 1C. DV930, TX-O, / 11 OPERATIONAL TRAINING UNIT, STEEPLE MORDEN / ON THE NIGHT OF 10TH-11TH SEPTEMBER 1942 THE ABOVE AIRCRAFT TOOK OFF FROM STEEPLE MORDEN AT / 21.05 HOURS AND CRASHED IN FLAMES INTO THE STACK YARD OF HERNE HILL FARM, CHEDISTON AT 23.45 / HOURS, AFTER RETURNING FROM A RAID ON DUSSELDORF IN GERMANY. THE AIRCRAFT WAS CARRYING A /CREW OF FIVE WHO ALL PERISHED / THE CREW MEMBERS WERE AS FOLLOWS: / Sgt Thomas Fraser Munro/ Sgt Jack Foden Stanley/ Sgt Kenneth Hamilton Vigers/ Sgt Robert Walter Freeman/ Sgt Andrew Scott Renwick // Tapestry: 75TH MEMORIAL/ RAF WELLINGTON CRASH/ HERNE HILL FARM/ 1942 - 2017/ Sgt Thomas Fraser Munro/ Sgt Jack Foden Stanley/ Sgt Kenneth Hamilton Vigers/ Sgt Robert Walter Freeman/ Sgt Andrew Scott Renwick

crew.name: Andrew Scott Renwick
crew.fate_detail: Died of injuries the following day
